scheme_name: Devnarayan Scooty Distribution And Incentive Scheme
other_conditions: Must belong to extremely backward classes of Rajasthan origin
Must have secured 50% or more marks in the 12th examination conducted by the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education or Central Board of Secondary Education
Must be admitted to Government Colleges or State Funded Universities located in Rajasthan
Must be studying regularly after being admitted in the first year of the bachelor's degree
Benefit of the Devnarayan Higher Education Financial Assistance Scheme or other financial assistance scheme will not be payable if received under this scheme
benefits_summary: Free distribution of 1500 scooties annually based on 12th merit, with financial assistance of ₹10,000 per year for undergraduate studies and up to ₹20,000 per year for postgraduate studies.
